name: cklph-visual-qa
description: Verify a rendered web page VISUALLY against a design — headless-Chrome screenshots, ImageMagick crop/compare, overflow probes, the adversarial visual-reviewer agent with a page-shape review, deterministic type, layout and page-shape lints (impeccable and Hallmark's page checker), and a copy lint for AI wording giveaways, all respecting a site's design exceptions. Framework-agnostic; pairs with cklph-figma.
